description: This file defines a simple in-memory rate limiting middleware using a sliding window counter for a web application, specifically utilizing the Starlette framework. It includes a class that manages request rate limits per key within a specified time window.

classes.name: RateLimitMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that enforces per-key rate limiting within a sliding window, based on request timestamps.

methods.name: __init__( self, app, requests: int, window_seconds: int, key_func: Callable[[dict], str], )
methods.description: Initializes the rate limit middleware with application, request count limit, window size, and key function.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next)
methods.description: Processes each request, enforces rate limiting by timestamp sliding window, and adds rate limit headers to response.

ctags.signature: ( self, app, requests: int, window_seconds: int, key_func: Callable[[dict], str], )

ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):$/
